Class View

java.lang.Object
View
public class View extends Object
Contains all of the Console Print methods.

Contains the printing methods for the different parts of the game.

  • Method Details

    • printMainMenu

      public void printMainMenu()
      Prints the graphics and choices for the Main Menu.

      Prints the choice to check Status, How to Play, and Quit. Also prints the choices to start a New Game, a New Game Plus, or to Continue depending on availability.

    • printStatus

      public void printStatus()
      Prints the lifetime stats of the Player.

    • printManual

      public void printManual()
      Prints a manual on how to play the game.

    • printIntro

      public void printIntro(int i)
      Prints the Intro sequence of the overworld.

      Called by Controller.startIntroSequence in order to print only parts of the output. It iterates through each of the cases here, with a Controller.waitForContinue call between prints.

      Parameters:
      i - indicates which set of prints to do.

    • printOverworldOptions

      public void printOverworldOptions()
      Prints the options for the player to choose from in the Overworld.

      Shows the options to start one of three Dungeons, use items, check their inventory, and quit. It also shows the Player's hp and gold.

    • printInventory

      public void printInventory()
      Displays the contents of the Player's Inventory.

    • printDungeon

      public void printDungeon()
      Displays the current Floor of the Dungeon.

      Prints the Dungeon information, Dungeon information, and the current Floor.

    • deathMessage

      public void deathMessage(String cause)
      Prints a death message if the Player dies.
      Parameters:
      cause - a string holding the name of the entity that caused the death.

    • finishedFloor

      public void finishedFloor(Idol idol)
      Prints a victory message if the Player clears a Dungeon.
      Parameters:
      idol - the Idol that the player rescued.

    • printChoicePrompt

      public void printChoicePrompt()
      Prints the prompt asking for the player's next choice.

      Also prints an error message or list of error messages grabbed from Model if any exist.

    • printContinuePrompt

      public void printContinuePrompt()
      Prints a prompt asking for the player to enter anything to continue. Used for cutscenes where the player's input does not matter.
